mapper.select: with ranked as ( select c.*, row_number() over (partition by c.kb_item_uuid order by c.chunk_index) as sample_rank, count(*) over (partition by c.kb_item_uuid) as sample_count from adi_knowledge_base_chunk c inner join adi_knowledge_base_item i on i.uuid = c.kb_item_uuid and i.active_chunk_set_uuid = c.chunk_set_uuid where c.kb_uuid = #{kbUuid} ) select id, uuid, chunk_set_id, chunk_set_uuid, kb_id, kb_uuid, kb_item_id, kb_item_uuid, chunk_index, content, content_hash, token_count, char_start, char_end, create_time, update_time from ranked where sample_rank = 1 or sample_rank = sample_count or sample_rank = ((sample_count + 1) / 2) -- Interleave documents so a large/early document cannot consume the -- entire bounded pool before other documents contribute a sample. order by sample_rank, md5(kb_item_uuid), chunk_index limit #{limit}
